Just Paws Animal Rescue is a not for profit animal rescue and rehoming organization, established in 2014. We are a foster based rescue based in the Greater Toronto Area of Ontario, Canada. 


Mission
Our mission is to rescue and rehome unwanted, abandoned, abused and unloved pets that find themselves alone and frightened in shelters. These animals give unconditional love and should receive the same love back. Unfortunately there is a need and while ever there is a need we will be there to help. Our long term goal is to build towards the opening of our own shelter and be able to help with behavioral issues, special needs, and to offer a haven to less adoptable pets.
